CustomField.description: F score based on payment rate. 5 is excellent consistency and 1 is critical.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Payment_Rate__c), NULL, IF( Payment_Rate__c >= 0.98, 5, IF( Payment_Rate__c >= 0.9, 4, IF( Payment_Rate__c >= 0.75, 3, IF(Payment_Rate__c >= 0.5, 2, 1) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Frequency Score
